prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1280; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good afternoon. This recorded statement is regarding the sideswipe collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording right now, but you can use the claim file. I'm the driver of the silver sedan.

Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?

A: I was on the feeder road in Katy, trying to move over into the right lane because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirror, I think, and I put my signal on. The other car was in the lane beside me and it just kind of drifted over as I started to merge.

Q: How far into the lane change were you when the contact happened?

A: Maybe a car length, a little more. The left side of my car scraped along the other vehicle's right side. I jerked the wheel back and the car spun a bit toward the curb.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began to move over?

A: I saw it, but it was back a bit. I didn't think it was close enough to be a problem.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes. I hit my head on the window frame and I've had a headache ever since. Light bothers my eyes, and I felt foggy for a while at the scene. My doctor has me resting and I'm not supposed to drive long distances.

Q: Did you go to a hospital or urgent care after the collision?

A: My husband took me to urgent care that evening. They did a scan and told me I have a concussion. I have follow-up appointments scheduled.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?

A: Just that I was being careful and signaling. I'd like the other driver's insurance to take responsibility, since they were the one who moved toward me.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you about your medical records and the vehicle inspection.

A: Okay. Thank you.
